text:
Anya (product): Hey team — proposing inline collapsible help panels for the network prerequisites step in the Private setup wizard. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123. Goals: reduce cognitive load, keep help contextually close to fields, and let users expand targeted checks. Looking for quick feedback on copy, collapse affordance, and accessibility nits.

Mike (eng): Love the idea. Quick Q: will expanded panels push the form layout or overlay? pushing feels simpler but could be long.

Jun (infra): For on-prem flows we should avoid expensive preflight runs on expand. Can we run lightweight client-side checks and queue heavier probes async with a status badge?

Sara (a11y): A11y notes: ensure the collapse control is a keyboard-focusable button with aria-expanded. When content appears, focus should not be stolen; instead announce updates via an aria-live region for check status. Contrast: any helper text that acts like a label needs >= 4.5:1, and secondary hints should meet 3:1. Also ensure visible focus outline and 1.5x target size for touch.

Anya (product): Thanks Sara — good call. Proposed copy for collapsed state: 'Quick checks and tips'. Expanded header copy: 'Network prerequisites and remediation steps'. Inline hint: 'Run checks now or continue and run them after deployment.' Thoughts?

Mike (eng): Implementation note: we can keep panels inline (push layout) and lazy-load heavy checks. Pseudo CSS for affordance: 
```
.help-toggle { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.help-toggle:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); }
```
Also will add aria-controls and aria-expanded on toggle.

Jun (infra): For heavy probes, background job + polling makes UX smooth. Show spinner + last-run timestamp. If user triggers manual 'Run checks' run immediate job with toast.

Sara (a11y): Add: role=region with aria-labelledby pointing to the heading inside the panel. Live region should be polite for non-blocking updates. For keyboard users, ensure the toggle is reachable before the field it refers to.

Anya (product): Great. Action items: I'll update figma to show inline push layout, revise copy per Sara, and add 'Run checks later' flow. Mike/Jon — can you estimate effort for lazy-load + live region? I'll create a QA ticket for contrast and focus checks. 

Mike (eng): Estimating 2 days to prototype the toggle + lazy-load checks, 1 day for accessibility tweaks with Sara's guidance.

Jun (infra): Sounds good. I'll draft backend job plan for async probes.

Anya (product): Thanks — will send updated frames. Closing for now, please add any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
